title: Collection Runner
description: Run all requests in a collection sequentially and view the results.
localOnly: The collection runner is only available when you are signed in — it needs the backend to orchestrate iterations, capture results, and persist runs. Sign in to use this feature.

data.hint: Each object in the array represents one iteration with its own variable set. Variables will be substituted in request URLs, headers, and body.

validation.notArray: Data must be a JSON array
validation.empty: Array must contain at least one item
validation.itemNotObject: Item at index {{index}} must be a JSON object
